layers.name: API Service Operations
layers.description: Implements Fastify API endpoints and application services for providers, prompts, memory, assets, imports, generation, costs, and illustrations.

layers.name: Build and Release Automation
layers.description: Defines dependency updates and GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration, container builds, and documentation deployment.

layers.name: World Domain Models
layers.description: Defines the core domain types and pure business rules for worlds, characters, entities, illustrations, canonical facts, and campaign transfers.

layers.name: Core Runtime Packages
layers.description: Provides shared runtime infrastructure for database access, logging, migrations, story generation, prompting, narration, chronicle memory, and model integration.

layers.name: Shared API Contracts
layers.description: Defines validated TypeScript contracts for worlds, campaigns, generation, imports, prompts, memory, users, assets, and related API data.

layers.name: Documentation Tooling
layers.description: This community contains the VitePress documentation site, architecture records, configuration, and documentation-supporting assets.

layers.name: Integration Tests
layers.description: This community contains database, API, gameplay, generation, import, migration, and image-pipeline integration tests.
